destinations.name: Mendocino Coast + Russian Gulch
destinations.quietWindow: Friday evening arrival, hike before 9:00 AM, late lunch after the day-tripper wave
destinations.whyFits: Coastal cliffs, redwoods, tide pools, and quiet inns make it feel planned and intimate without blowing the budget.

lodging.name: Quiet Mendocino inn or cabin
lodging.notes: Book a small inn away from Main Street for quiet mornings and easy trail access.

transportLinks.label: Route from San Francisco to Mendocino

trails.name: Russian Gulch Waterfall Loop
trails.crowdTip: Start from the state park side before most coastal visitors arrive.
trails.reviewSignal: Consistently praised for redwoods, fern canyon, and a real payoff waterfall.

trails.name: Mendocino Headlands bluff walk
trails.crowdTip: Walk the western bluff sections instead of the closest village overlooks.
trails.reviewSignal: Low effort, high reward coastal views.

destinations.name: Lassen Volcanic + Mineral
destinations.quietWindow: Shoulder season weekend, arrive Friday, hike early while day visitors are still driving in
destinations.whyFits: Big volcanic scenery without Yosemite-level crowds, with quiet cabins and hot-springs energy nearby.
risks: Snow can close high-elevation trails early in season
Food options are limited near the park

lodging.name: Mineral or Chester cabin/motel
lodging.notes: Choose simple lodging close to the south entrance to maximize trail time.

transportLinks.label: Route from San Francisco to Lassen Volcanic

trails.name: Bumpass Hell
trails.bestTime: first legal trail window after road/trail opening
trails.crowdTip: Go early and avoid holiday weekends.
trails.reviewSignal: Hydrothermal boardwalks make it feel unlike a normal California hike.

trails.name: Kings Creek Falls
trails.crowdTip: Start before 8:30 AM and picnic after the return.
trails.reviewSignal: Waterfall payoff, meadow approach, and manageable distance.

destinations.name: Tucson + Saguaro National Park
destinations.quietWindow: Fly Friday, dawn hike Saturday, pool/food recovery in the afternoon
destinations.whyFits: Desert trails, huge sky, and warm evenings feel like a real surprise without needing an international budget.
risks: Flights can push the package near the budget ceiling

lodging.name: Quiet casita or boutique hotel near Catalina Foothills
lodging.notes: Prioritize a calm patio and short drive to trailheads.

trails.name: Wasson Peak via King Canyon
trails.crowdTip: Start at sunrise and avoid the hottest window.
trails.reviewSignal: Classic Sonoran views and a summit that feels earned.

trails.name: Mica View + Cactus Forest Loop
trails.crowdTip: Use it as a quiet Sunday morning walk before flying home.
trails.reviewSignal: Dense saguaro scenery without a punishing climb.

destinations.name: Bend + Sisters
destinations.quietWindow: Stay in Sisters or west Bend, hike early, avoid downtown Saturday night
destinations.whyFits: A polished outdoors weekend with volcanic trails, rivers, and good food, but it needs crowd-aware timing.

lodging.name: Sisters lodge or quiet west Bend stay
lodging.notes: Sisters is calmer than downtown Bend and closer to several quiet trailheads.

trails.name: Tam McArthur Rim
trails.crowdTip: Pick shoulder season and start at first light.
trails.reviewSignal: Big Cascade views without needing an all-day sufferfest.

trails.name: Shevlin Park Loop
trails.crowdTip: Use it as a low-stress second hike before brunch.
trails.reviewSignal: Ponderosa forest and creek scenery close to town.

destinations.name: Ojai + Los Padres
destinations.quietWindow: Stay outside the main village, hike early, do dinner after the day crowd clears
destinations.whyFits: Warm, romantic, and hikeable, but the drive is longer and Ojai can get crowded on pretty weekends.
risks: Boutique lodging can crush the budget

lodging.name: Small inn near Ojai or Ventura foothills
lodging.notes: Avoid premium spa resorts if the budget matters.

transportLinks.label: Route from San Francisco to Ojai

trails.name: Shelf Road
trails.crowdTip: Walk before breakfast or at golden hour, not midday.
trails.reviewSignal: Easy views over Ojai with minimal planning.

trails.name: Cozy Dell Trail
trails.crowdTip: Start early and bring water; exposed sections get warm.
trails.reviewSignal: Classic Ojai foothill climb with valley views.
